title: Frozen Time and Rewind in a 1950s Diner
desc: A 30-second Seedance 2.5 script that locks a diner spill at its peak, orbits the suspended coffee ribbons for a full circle, rewinds every person and droplet back to the exact starting positions, then erases the accident with a single casual wave.
prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic 1950s American diner, chrome stools, red vinyl, neon glow and checkerboard floor, shot with modern lived-in realism and soft natural window light. Subtle handheld texture, warm practicals, rich period detail, heavy film grain.

0-4s: [Medium Wide] A striking young woman in her early 20s sits alone at the counter, calm and slightly amused, slowly sipping a tall thick milkshake through a straw. Behind her a young waitress in classic uniform approaches with a tray of eggs and bacon in one hand and a full glass coffee pot in the other. An older lady starts rising from a nearby booth.

4-8s: [Dynamic Tracking] The older lady collides hard into the waitress. Tray, plate, eggs, bacon and coffee pot explode upward in chaotic slow motion. Coffee erupts into long liquid ribbons and perfect suspended droplets. Camera immediately begins a smooth continuous orbit around the impact. Time locks completely at the peak of the spill. Every face freezes in pure shock. Only the girl at the counter keeps moving, completely unfazed.

8-17s: [Slow 360° Orbital] Camera glides in a full elegant orbit through the frozen diner. Coffee hangs in mid-air as glassy ribbons and spheres with perfect volume and surface tension. Bacon strips, eggs and the spinning tray float weightlessly. Patrons and waitress remain locked in startled expressions. The girl at the counter takes one slow, deliberate sip, eyes half-lidded, almost bored, while the entire frozen world (except her) begins an elegant reverse: every droplet, every piece of food and every person rewinds smoothly back to the exact starting positions.

17-24s: [Medium Shot] Rewind lands perfectly. Waitress stands balanced again with tray and coffee pot. The girl lifts her eyes, raises two fingers in a small casual gesture and softly calls the waitress by name. The waitress turns toward her just before the older lady begins to stand, completely avoiding the collision. A tiny private smile crosses the girl’s face.

24-30s: [Extreme Close-Up] Hard cut to her face as she takes one last slow sip. Soft knowing smile, eyes almost closed in quiet satisfaction, like she has done this a hundred times. Shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh of the neon diner behind her.

Photorealistic, ultra-detailed fluid physics, perfect motion blur only on moving elements, stable characters, cinematic lighting, heavy natural film grain, no artifacts, movie-level temporal coherence, high rewatch value.

title: Meilin-Element Kung Fu Performance
desc: A real video case from X / 𝕏, published by @aimikoda. Useful for observing prompt structure, material organization, and reusable creation patterns.
prompt:
GPT Image 2 Prompt:

Create a raw kung fu performance storyboard focused on extreme physical action. Use reference image for the character.

16:9 storyboard sheet, 12 cinematic panels. The actual storyboard drawings must be black and white only: rough pencil lines, minimal detail, fast gesture drawing energy, simple anatomy construction and strong silhouette readability. Keep the artwork lightweight, dynamic and unfinished like early fight choreography previs.

Start directly in action. Do not begin with a calm stance, preparation shot or slow introduction.

A solitary female performer executes an aggressive Tibetan kung fu master-style routine inside a vast ancient temple. The choreography is exaggerated, explosive and constantly escalating: flying diagonal kicks, monk-style low stances, rapid palm strikes, spinning cloth-like body turns, animal-form hand shapes, deep lunges, aerial twists, floor-level sweeps, sudden drops, claw-like blocks, back-arched jumps, sliding recoveries and violent sculptural impact poses.

Every panel must contain visible motion and strong body momentum. Avoid static standing poses. The performer should feel like a ritual warrior moving with discipline, fury, spiritual pressure and total body control.

Action progression:
1. begin mid-air with a flying diagonal kick already in motion
2. handheld close-up palm sweep cutting through air
3. orbiting wide shot of a full-body spin
4. low-angle impact palm strike with shockwave
5. long-lens side profile spinning kick
6. top-down aerial turn with body, hair and fabric flaring outward
7. hard floor stomp cracking the temple stone
8. sliding low sweep across the floor
9. aggressive close-up flurry of elbows, palms and backfist strikes
10. extreme low monk-style beast stance with energy rising
11. spinning elemental vortex around the body
12. final airborne action pose, suspended above the temple floor, body twisted in a powerful kung fu strike, all elements converging around her before impact

Add selective elemental energy effects as VFX-style storyboard accents. The effects should feel spiritual, ritualistic and cinematic, not superhero-like:
air bursts around spins and flying kicks,
dust and stone fragments lifting from stomps,
water-like floor ripples during slides,
fire-like trails around explosive strikes,
heat distortion around high-intensity movement,
elemental vortex near the climax.

Element progression:
early panels: subtle wind, dust and pressure lines
middle panels: stronger stone fragments, floor ripples and air shockwaves
late panels: controlled fire trails and energy spirals
final panel: the strongest combined elemental surge while the performer is still airborne

Use cinematic arthouse action camerawork:
handheld energy,
whip-pan feeling,
orbiting camera moves,
overhead shots,
side silhouettes,
aggressive close-ups,
long-lens compression,
extreme low angles,
wide negative space,
strong parallax.

Keep the temple environment minimal and atmospheric:
towering stone columns,
worn temple floor,
drifting incense smoke,
hanging fabric,
harsh light shafts,
faint dust in the air,
subtle wet floor reflections.
Do not overcrowd the frames.

Annotation color system:
red arrows = body movement
blue arrows = camera movement
green marks = framing / composition notes
orange marks = lighting direction
yellow marks = elemental VFX / energy effects
black text = short lens notes and panel labels

No timestamps. No dialogue. No singing. No extra characters. No enemies. No logos. No watermark.


Seedance 2.0 Prompt:

Create a 15-second cinematic kung fu performance video.

Use @[image1]  as the fixed character sheet reference. The character must strictly match the character sheet.
Use @[image2]  as the storyboard reference.

Follow the storyboard shot by shot as the main source for action order, camera rhythm, body movement, framing, movement direction, camera angles and visual progression. Treat each storyboard panel as a sequential keyframe. Preserve the shot order and make the video feel like the storyboard has been translated into continuous live-action motion. The sequence must end on a frozen final frame while the performer is still airborne.

Do not add text, captions, storyboard labels, arrows, UI, logos or watermarks. Do not treat the storyboard as a single image. Do not redesign the character, change the costume or alter the face. Do not begin with a calm stance, preparation pose or slow introduction. Do not make the elemental effects look like superhero powers or excessive fantasy glow.

Visual style:
stylized cinematic realism, high-end 3D painterly animation quality, dynamic cloth simulation, expressive silhouette design, rich cinematic lighting, controlled color palette, natural motion blur, dramatic scale, beautiful but aggressive physicality, premium feature-animation aesthetic.

Environment:
vast ancient temple, towering stone columns, worn temple floor, drifting incense smoke, hanging fabric, harsh light shafts, faint dust in the air, subtle wet floor reflections, high contrast shadows.

The performance is a solitary female kung fu routine inside a vast ancient temple. The routine starts immediately in action, with no calm stance, no preparation pose and no slow introduction. The movement should feel aggressive, ritualistic, disciplined, physically extreme and spiritually charged.

This is not a fight against an enemy. It is a solo performance of force, control, exhaustion, fury and release.

Follow story board for choreography direction.

Element progression:
early sequence: subtle wind, dust and pressure lines responding to movement.
middle sequence: stronger air shockwaves, stone fragments, floor cracks and water-like ripples across the temple floor.
late sequence: controlled fire trails, heat distortion and energy spirals around explosive strikes and kicks.
climax: wind, dust, stone, water ripple and fire accents combine into a stronger elemental vortex.
final beat: the performer is airborne above the temple floor in a powerful kung fu strike, body twisted mid-air, hair and fabric flaring outward, with all elements converging around her before impact.

Elemental VFX must feel spiritual, ritualistic and cinematic. The effects should be integrated with the choreography and motivated by physical movement. Keep the energy raw, elemental, atmospheric and grounded in the temple environment.

Use Laban movement logic throughout:
weight: strong, heavy, grounded during impacts, with brief lightness during jumps and aerial twists
time: quick during strikes, kicks, drops and turns, sustained during suspended holds and recovery transitions
space: direct during attacks, blocks and lunges, indirect during spinning turns and elemental vortex moments
flow: bound during rooted stances and precise strikes, free during aerial motion, spinning fabric movement and elemental release

title: Selfie-Style Skincare UGC Ad
desc: GPT Image 2 first fixes the character, a front-facing product photo is added, and Seedance 2.5 then makes a 15-second vertical selfie voiceover ad. The prompt locks the four beats, spoken lines, handheld feel and label text, so the face does not drift and the bottle text stays intact.
prompt:
A 15-second vertical (9:16) ultra-photorealistic close-up vlog clip, filmed on a phone held at arm's length. Not an ad. A girl talking to her own camera at the end of the day, the way people actually film themselves.
TALENT —
Young woman, early-to-mid 20s. Long light-brown hair with soft caramel balayage, middle part, loose undone waves, a few strands stuck to her cheek. Fair-to-light-tan skin with visible freckles across the nose and cheeks, thick natural brows, blue-green eyes, bare face, small blue resin hoop earrings, thin gold chain with a small pearl pendant. Face, freckles, hair and eye color must 100% match the reference. Oversized white linen button-down over a fitted white ribbed top, fully covered, collar slightly crooked, sleeves pushed up.
PRODUCT —
LANEIGE Water Sleeping Mask_EX, 70 ml. Frosted translucent light-blue glass jar, smooth matte cobalt-blue screw lid. Front label reads, in this exact order: "LANEIGE" in wide-spaced capitals, "WATER SLEEPING MASK_EX" below it, then "SLEEPING MICROBIOME" and "BRIGHTENING · HYDRATING · SOFTENING" in smaller pale-yellow type, then "70 ml" at the base. Inside, thick pale mint-blue gel with a wet glossy surface that holds a soft peak. Shape, color, gel texture and all label text must 100% match the reference, correctly spelled, legible whenever in focus.
LOCATION
A villa bedroom at golden hour. Only fragments read in frame because the camera is so tight: white stucco wall, a corner of rumpled white linen bedding, blurred bougainvillea and olive leaves through an open door behind her. The background stays soft and mostly out of focus the entire time.
LIGHTING
One condition, unchanged across all four beats. Low warm sun from frame-left through the open door, roughly 4800K, soft white-wall bounce filling the shadow side of her face. Warm rim on the left edge of her hair and jaw. Slight blown highlight where the sun clips her cheek. No ring light, no fill, no glam lighting.
FRAMING
Close-up throughout. Her face fills most of the frame in every beat, chin to just above the hairline, never wider than upper-chest. The jar enters frame close to her face, never held out toward the lens.
0:00–0:04
Visual: Tight front-camera close-up, slightly below eye level. She's mid-motion already, pushing hair off her face with the back of her wrist. She glances just off-lens, checking her own image, then back. The jar comes up beside her cheek, held low and casual, only the top half in frame, lid already off. A slow exhale through the nose.
Camera: Selfie camera, arm's length, natural handheld drift, one quick autofocus hunt between her face and the jar.
Dialogue: "Okay. Last thing, then bed."
0:04–0:07
Visual: She tips the jar slightly and drags two fingertips through the gel. Macro-tight: her fingertips, the wet mint-blue surface, a fine thread of gel stretching and snapping. The "LANEIGE" and "WATER SLEEPING MASK_EX" lines cross the frame in focus for a beat. Her face stays partly in frame at the edge, out of focus.
Camera: Same front camera pushed in close, shallow focus, rack from the label to the gel on her fingers.
Dialogue: "It's cold, by the way."
0:07–0:11
Visual: Back to her face, closer now. She taps the gel across one cheek, her forehead, her chin, then presses it in flat-palmed, working outward. The gel flashes milky over her skin, then settles clear with a faint sheen. She winces at the cold, blinks it off, keeps going. Freckles, pores and natural under-eye shadows stay visible right through the layer. She's talking while working, not pausing for the line.
Camera: Selfie camera, very close, small handheld corrections, a slow drift as she turns her cheek toward the light.
Dialogue: "Thin layer. You don't wash it off."
0:11–0:15
Visual: Closest framing of the clip. She presses two fingertips against her cheek and lets them lift, feeling the faint tack. Turns her head slowly through the low sun, checking the sheen along her cheekbone, eyes tracking her own reflection in the screen rather than the lens. A short nod. The corner of the blue jar sits soft-focus in the lower frame edge, label partly readable. She reaches to stop the recording and the frame tilts as her hand moves.
Camera: Selfie camera, slow handheld orbit from three-quarter profile to straight-on, ending on her face filling the frame, then a small tilt as she reaches.
Dialogue: "Morning me is gonna be so happy."
PERFORMANCE
End-of-day, low energy, unperformed. She talks the way someone talks while doing something else, lines half-thrown-away, not projected. Micro-behavior carries the beats: a slow blink, a genuine flinch at the cold, a half-smile that arrives late, eyes checking her own reflection instead of the lens, one natural swallow, visible breath, a small unconscious head tilt. No presenter voice, no bright delivery, no exaggerated reactions, no pointing at the product.
VOICE
Soft, slightly flat, close to the mic because the phone is at arm's length. Natural room tone around it. Unhurried, a little tired. Ordinary speaking volume with a touch of breath on the ends of words.
REALISM
Pore-level skin realism: visible pores across the nose and cheeks, fine forehead texture, natural freckling, faint under-eye shadows, a small blemish near the jaw, stray flyaway hairs catching the backlight, vellus hair on the cheek edge. Wet living eyes with catch-lights and natural asymmetric blinking. The gel reads as a real cosmetic layer refracting light on top of her skin, never replacing its texture.
PHYSICS
Gel holds a soft peak on her fingertip and slumps under pressure. Hair moves with real inertia and a few strands fall back across her face. Linen creases and drapes naturally. The jar has real weight and correct contact shadow against her hand. Camera weight shifts naturally with her arm.
CAMERA CHARACTER
Authentic modern smartphone selfie footage. Natural handheld tremor throughout, small framing corrections, quick autofocus hunts, mild wide-angle distortion at close range, natural rolling shutter, real motion blur, slight sensor noise in the shadow side. Never feels stabilized or operated by anyone else.
STYLE
Real personal vlog, iPhone-shot look, high-end photorealistic quality. Warm golden-hour daylight, real ambient evening atmosphere, no retouching, no skin smoothing, no product-hero framing, no before/after transformation, no commercial polish.
OUTPUT SETTINGS
9:16 vertical. 15 seconds. Real-time motion. High-detail photorealistic 8K intent. Natural smartphone motion blur and subtle sensor noise.
POSITIVE LOCKS
 keeps the same face, freckles, hair, earrings, necklace and white linen shirt over white ribbed top in every beat, fully covered throughout.
 stays the same frosted blue jar with matte cobalt lid, correct one-hand size, label text correctly spelled and legible whenever in focus, sharpest in the 0:04–0:07 beat.
Exactly two arms and two hands visible, anatomically correct with five fingers, one hand always holding the phone.
Same room, same wardrobe, same golden-hour lighting from first frame to last.
Close-up framing held throughout, her face dominant in every beat.
Spoken dialogue exactly as written, in order, at the stated timings, with accurate natural lip-sync.
Natural ambient audio only: faint breeze, distant birds, the small click of the lid, room tone. No music, no on-screen text, no captions, no subtitles, no logos other than the product's own packaging.

prompt:
Create a 30-second fast-paced cinematic Japanese anime cooking video showing the preparation of authentic katsudon, entirely from the text description below.

IMPORTANT: Do not display, recreate, trace, reference, or imitate any storyboard, sketch, reference image, panel, annotation, or source material. Generate only original anime-style animation.

STYLE

High-quality Japanese anime film style, cinematic summer lighting, ultra-detailed food textures, realistic cooking physics, visible steam and moisture, shallow depth of field, macro close-ups, smooth camera movement, warm Japanese kitchen atmosphere. Fast rhythmic editing with natural match cuts based on movement, shape, texture, and composition.

TIMELINE

0–2.5s — Prepare Pork
Close-up of hands pounding a thick pork loin with a wooden mallet on a cutting board. The meat gradually flattens and its fibers loosen. Sprinkle salt and pepper evenly. Crisp rhythmic impacts.

2.5–5s — Bread the Pork
Quick match cuts: press the pork into flour, dip into beaten egg, then firmly coat with coarse panko breadcrumbs. Show realistic egg dripping and breadcrumbs adhering to the surface.

5–7.5s — Fry
Lower the breaded pork into hot golden oil. Intense bubbling surrounds the cutlet as the crust turns golden brown and crispy. Warm cinematic lighting and detailed oil movement.

7.5–9.5s — Slice
Place the fried tonkatsu on a wooden board. A sharp knife cuts it into even strips. The crispy crust cracks naturally, revealing juicy white pork with gentle steam escaping.

9.5–12s — Simmer Dashi & Onion
Thinly sliced onions gently simmer in amber dashi inside a shallow pan. Small bubbles rise while the onions become translucent. Chopsticks gently move them through the broth.

12–14s — Add Tonkatsu
Place the sliced tonkatsu carefully over the simmering onions using chopsticks. The broth begins soaking into the crispy edges while steam rises.

14–16.5s — Pour Egg
Slowly pour beaten golden egg over the tonkatsu and onions. The egg spreads naturally through the gaps and begins setting around the hot edges.

16.5–19s — Set the Egg
Close-up of the egg gently coagulating over low heat. Edges become soft and golden while the center remains glossy, slightly runny, and trembling. No stirring.

19–21s — Prepare Rice
A white ceramic donburi bowl receives a generous mound of steaming Japanese short-grain rice. The rice looks fluffy and slightly glossy.

21–24s — Assemble
Carefully slide the egg-and-tonkatsu mixture from the pan onto the rice. The egg settles naturally in a soft wave while dashi lightly absorbs into the rice.

24–26s — Final Close-Up
The finished katsudon rests on the counter. Glossy egg slowly settles over the tonkatsu and rice, gently trembling. Slow cinematic push-in.

26–30s — Hero Reveal
Present the finished katsudon in a traditional blue-and-white ceramic bowl on a wooden surface. Golden egg covers crispy tonkatsu over glossy rice, topped with fresh mitsuba. Steam rises as the camera slowly arcs around the bowl for a beautiful anime-food-film ending.

AUDIO

Bright 1980s-inspired Japanese city-pop instrumental, 110–120 BPM, with subtle koto and light chime percussion. Synchronize realistic ASMR cooking sounds: mallet impacts, knife slicing, frying sizzle, bubbling dashi, chopsticks, egg pouring, steam, and a soft ceramic clink.

End with one delicate wind-chime tone during the final reveal.

NEGATIVE

No storyboard, reference image, sketch, panels, borders, numbers, arrows, annotations, subtitles, captions, UI, logos, or text overlays. No unrelated ingredients or dishes. Katsudon only. Keep the food, hands, utensils, lighting, and environment visually consistent throughout.

A woman calmly faces a charging zombie horde. She inserts white wireless earbuds, starts her music, and clears the avenue with effortless telekinesis. Relaxed shoulders, steady breathing, small finger and wrist gestures. Never show strain, trembling, clenched teeth, exhaustion, bracing, or loss of balance.

She is quietly confident, with a faint smile and subtle head movements to the music. No exaggerated dancing.

Telekinesis is invisible. Show it through object movement, displaced air, disturbed puddles, and sliding papers. No beams, glowing hands, magical symbols, or luminous shields.

A wide downtown intersection after rain, under overcast daylight. Wet asphalt, puddles, isolated fires, thin smoke, damaged brick buildings, broken shop windows, abandoned vehicles, scattered glass and papers. Visibility remains clear.

- A damaged enclosed pedestrian skybridge spans the avenue forty meters ahead. Missing glass, sagging central section, cracked connections.

- The side street on her left is clear beyond the parked bus. Once the bus is lifted away, this exit is open.

ZOMBIES

They never wait motionless during her attacks. Their delays come from knockback, falling, recovering, and negotiating wreckage.

She looks up and casually raises her hand, gently curling her fingers.

A brief structural insert shows existing cracks widening and damaged connections bending under her force. Small fragments fall.

Her face remains calm. The music builds.

00:25–00:28 — COLLAPSE
Return wide, connecting her gesture with the distant bridge.

She lowers her hand effortlessly.

The central span breaks free and falls directly onto the bus and the street immediately behind it. It crushes the bus roof and blocks the remaining horde.

Concrete, twisted steel, and the wrecked bus create one continuous barrier across the avenue.

The released span falls with believable gravity. Steel bends, concrete fractures, glass breaks, and dust expands around the impact.

Heavy debris stays in the distant collapse zone. Only the bridge and its damaged connections fail; both surrounding buildings remain standing.

The impact lands on the strongest musical accent: deep rumbling, tearing metal, falling masonry.

00:28–00:30 — EXIT
Eye-level medium-wide shot from inside the clear side street to her left, looking back toward the intersection.

She turns into it and takes a few confident steps toward the retreating camera. Her route is open because the bus has been removed.

The blocked avenue and rising dust remain visible behind her.

A subtle head movement follows the music. Hands relaxed, normal breathing, no fatigue. No additional earbud adjustment.

A faint breeze moves her hair. No heavy debris reaches her.

End at exactly thirty seconds on her forward movement. No extra scene or title.

CAMERA AND EDITING
Coherent live-action movie coverage, motivated cuts, and readable trajectories.

Use eye-level wide and medium-wide shots for major actions. Show the heroine, controlled object, and target together when possible.

Close-ups only for earbuds, facial performance, and brief structural details.

Maintain screen direction and recognizable landmarks. Controlled tracking, natural perspective, realistic motion blur, restrained impact vibration.

No constant shaking, random whip pans, spinning camera, extreme distortion, gameplay camera, or cuts that hide impacts. No prolonged slow motion.

LIGHTING AND MATERIALS
Soft gray daylight, natural skin tones, restrained orange fire reflections.

Realistic skin, hair, fabric, wet asphalt, dirty glass, heavy steel, and concrete dust. Preserve reference colors without making hair or clothing glow.

Telekinesis is supernatural; everything affected behaves like real physical material.

No cartoon rendering, plastic faces, excessive bloom, or game-engine surfaces.

Exposed apocalypse ambience until the earbud tap, then a shift into her listening perspective and an original dark electronic instrumental with strong bass and percussion.

Music continues through all cuts. Gestures and major impacts align with accents. Keep collisions and destruction audible above it.

No lyrics, dialogue, narration, or subtitles.

CONTINUITY
One consistent heroine matching the photo. Earbuds stay in place.
Objects exist before moving; wreckage persists afterward.
Zombies recover and advance instead of waiting.
The bus starts beside her, moves ahead, then attacks.
No zombies remain between her and the deployed bus.
The bus stops beneath the bridge.
The bridge falls before zombies cross the bus.

Every major movement follows her gesture. She never strains or becomes tired.

No low-angle opening, civilians, rescue subplot, game aesthetic, interface, glowing outlines, text, logos, watermarks, captions, or end title.

Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic early-2000s consumer DV camcorder home video of a young Korean couple going for a casual afternoon drive through Seoul. The footage should feel like a genuine memory recorded by a friend, imperfect and spontaneous rather than a polished commercial.

=== CHARACTERS ===

GIRL: Young adult Korean woman in her early 20s, naturally beautiful, realistic skin, minimal makeup, long slightly wavy dark hair tied loosely with a few strands framing her face. Ll

BOYFRIEND: Young adult Korean man in his early 20s, natural hairstyle, realistic skin, relaxed expression, wearing a loose white T-shirt, dark jeans and white sneakers. Keep his appearance consistent.

=== STORY ===

She waits outside her apartment building with a small shoulder bag, checking her phone and looking down the street. Her boyfriend arrives in an older compact car and smiles when he sees her. She opens the passenger door, gets inside and playfully looks toward the camera as if embarrassed about being filmed.

They drive slowly through an older Seoul neighborhood. She sits in the passenger seat with the window slightly open, enjoying the breeze while her hair moves naturally. Her boyfriend occasionally glances at her and smiles while keeping his attention on the road.

They stop at a small neighborhood convenience store. She gets out, buys two cold drinks and returns to the car. She hands one to her boyfriend, keeps the other for herself, and they laugh together before continuing the drive.

Later, they park near a quiet riverside road. They get out and walk beside the parked car, talking casually. She takes a sip of her drink, makes a playful expression at the taste, and he laughs. She lightly pushes his shoulder and they continue walking together.

A gentle breeze moves through her hair. He notices a strand across her face and gently moves it aside. She smiles and looks at him for a moment. They stand close together beside the car, sharing a quiet romantic moment.

Near the end, she looks toward the camera and laughs shyly, then turns back toward her boyfriend. He steps closer, she smiles, and they share a brief, natural kiss. They pull back, laugh softly and remain standing close together as the camera keeps recording.

The boyfriend looks toward the camera and jokingly shakes his head while she hides her face against his shoulder, laughing.

Raw early-2000s consumer DV camcorder footage. Handheld camera operated by a friend sitting in the back seat and later walking with them. Imperfect framing, subtle handheld shake, autofocus hunting, occasional exposure shifts, faded summer colors, soft digital detail, mild sensor noise, natural motion blur and occasional accidental zooms. No stabilization and no polished cinematic movement.

=== AUDIO ===

Built-in camcorder microphone only. Car engine, road noise, turn signals, window breeze, distant Seoul traffic, convenience-store door chime, refrigerator hum, footsteps, birds, neighborhood voices, fabric movement and natural laughter. Their dialogue should feel casual and partially imperfect like a real home video. No music, no narration, no subtitles.

=== REALISM / CONTINUITY ===

Keep the same couple, faces, hairstyles, outfits, accessories and car throughout. Natural Korean facial features, realistic hands and fingers, believable walking, sitting, driving and kissing. Hair and clothing react naturally to the breeze and movement. Genuine expressions rather than exaggerated acting.

TEAM LEADER: man in his 40s, 170 cm, average build, full head of short black hair parted at the side, thin metal-framed glasses, white dress shirt with a loosened navy tie. Appears only beside the first desk cluster, checking his watch.

LOCATION MAP

One unbroken spatial route the camera travels with her:

Her workstation → low desk partition → printer aisle → corridor T-junction → meeting-room alcove with mobile whiteboard → elevator lobby → elevator interior.

Keep the route compact and physically traversable within the 27-second continuous section.

Foreground: polished linoleum floor, office desks, steel filing cabinets, rolling chairs, and reflective glass meeting-room partitions.

ELEVATOR GEOMETRY

First frame is already in motion: NAGI darts in from lower-left toward camera-right, work tote clutched to her chest, and drops into a crouch-slide behind a low desk partition beside her workstation.

Camera behind her right shoulder. Game HUD fully visible from frame one.

A small desk clock reads 17:00.

FORMAT MODE

One continuous unbroken take from 0.0s to 27.0s with no cuts of any kind, then a single HARD CUT at 27.0s to one final locked reverse shot that runs to 30.0s.

Exactly one cut exists in the whole video, at 27.0s. The camera does not cut anywhere else.

OPTICS

One lens for the continuous section: 47° third-person over-the-shoulder framing as the baseline, breathing in to 29° on reaction beats and out to 63° for the boss encounter and moving-whiteboard concealment.

All FOV changes in that section happen as smooth continuous zoom breathing, never as a jump.

CAMERA

For the continuous section, the camera is a physical object flying with her.

Chest-height, 1.5 meters behind NAGI, slightly camera-right of her spine, swinging with a soft spring delay half a beat behind her turns like an analog-stick gameplay camera.

It dips to knee height when she crouches, rises when she stands, slides sideways along the filing cabinets with her, swings wide to corridor-left to reveal the boss encounter, drifts behind her for the moving whiteboard, and follows her through the open elevator doorway.

After the cut, the camera is repositioned inside the elevator beside the doorway, looking inward at NAGI — locked off, eye level, completely static, no movement.

ACTION

[Beat 1 — 0.0s to 6.0s]

NAGI crouch-slides behind the low desk partition, back flat against it, chest heaving. She leans out 20 cm to peek at the TEAM LEADER checking his watch beside the adjacent desk cluster, then pulls back.

[Beat 3 — 12.0s to 18.0s]

The whiteboard is a tall, opaque rectangular board on a metal frame with four caster wheels. Its panel extends low enough to conceal NAGI’s crouched torso and head; only her white sneakers occasionally show below the frame.

NAGI crouches on the side opposite the BOSS and shuffles with the board, matching its rolling speed exactly. She keeps her tote tucked close so it never protrudes beyond the board’s edge.

The alert bar drains to green.

[Beat 5 — 24.0s to 27.0s]

She slips through the clear doorway. The camera follows her inside, staying behind her shoulder.

She turns to face the entrance and presses the door-close button once. Her shoulders remain tense, tote held tightly in both hands.

The doors remain open until the cut.

9-15s: [Slow Orbital + Detail] Camera slowly orbits the frozen cars. The wig hangs mid-air in a twisted shape with individual hairs suspended. The bald man's scalp is fully exposed, mouth open. The woman behind is frozen mid-scream with the wig draped over her face. The young woman looks sideways, rolls her eyes and mouths "joder, otra vez". She reaches into her pocket, pulls out a stick of chewing gum, unwraps it and calmly puts it in her mouth, starting to chew while the entire frozen scene (except her) begins a precise reverse.

15-20s: [Medium Close-up] The rewind is controlled and elegant: the wig lifts off the woman behind, flies backward through the air in reverse, and returns exactly to the moment it is only beginning to peel off the bald man's head. Time freezes again at that precise instant — the front edge of the wig just lifting, a few strands already loose.

20-26s: [Tight Medium] Still frozen for everyone else, the young woman takes the chewed gum out of her mouth, reaches over and firmly presses it onto the center of the bald man's scalp, right under the lifting wig. With the same hand she smooths and presses the wig back down into perfect place, locking it with the gum. She sits back, looks straight ahead with a tiny private smile, completely unbothered.

26-30s: [Medium Shot] Time suddenly resumes at full real-time speed. The coaster continues its drop. The man touches his head, feels the wig still firmly in place, looks confused for a second, then breaks into a relieved, happy smile. The young woman stares forward, already chewing a new piece of gum, expression of quiet satisfaction.

title: Seedance 2.5 GoPro Fishing to Campfire Cook in One Run
desc: A 30-second chest-mounted GoPro short in four hard cuts: casting, cleaning the trout, grilling over a campfire, eating. Props, focal lengths, physics, light and sound are pinned down.
prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
POV river-to-campfire sequence at a jade-green alpine river through birch/cedar forest, late-afternoon light. A trout is caught, cleaned, seasoned, grilled over an open fire, then eaten, with one sip from a glass bottle while it cooks. 30s, four continuous segments, three hard cuts, real chest-mounted action camera.

ACTIVE REFERENCES

@location1
: jade-green river, granite boulders, gravel bar, stone fire-ring, tree-stump table, birch/cedar tree line, faint peaks. 100% matches reference.

@hands1
: sun-tanned forearms, light-blond arm hair, olive sleeve rolled to elbow, braided wrist cord. Same fly rod, folding knife, wood board, wire grill basket, plain glass bottle, brown fizzy liquid, no label. 100% matches reference.

LOCATION MAP
Segment A: river foreground, tree line behind. Segments B-D: gravel bar foreground, fire-ring and stump table midground, tree line and peaks background. POV chest-to-eye height, moving only with the body. Key light low, behind camera-left.

FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING
Non-empty opening frame: already mid-cast, rod raised, line already peeling off the reel. Water fills the lower two-thirds, forest/sky the top third.

FORMAT MODE
Controlled multi-shot, three HARD CUTs, camera does not cut anywhere else:
A (0-9s) river, one continuous take. HARD CUT.
B (9-21s) board, one continuous take. HARD CUT.
C (21-27s) fire, one continuous take. HARD CUT.
D (27-30s) eating, one continuous take.

OPTICS
84° in A easing to 63° through the fight. 63° easing to 18° across B. 63° opening to 29° in C. 29° held in D. No drift within any segment.

CAMERA
Chest-height POV, moving only with body motion — forward stroke on the cast, downward tilt on the knife and grate, forward lean when hands work close. Soft highlight roll-off on bright water and hot metal.

ACTION
A: rod arcs, line whistles; tip snaps down as the trout strikes; rod pumps, reel clicking, fish surfacing closer each pump; hand closes behind the gills, lifts the fish clear, holds it still one beat as water streams off. B: boots cross the gravel, fish set on the board, knife meets scales, scrapes tail to head; one clean line opens the belly, organs lift free; fish rinses in the shallows, pink cloud drifting off; salt, pepper, herbs scatter over the flesh; fish folds into the basket, latch clacks. C: kindling catches from a breath, flame licks up; basket lowers onto the grate, skin bubbles and browns, smoke lifts. D: bottle tips up for one swallow; fork pauses a half-second at the flesh before splitting it open, steam lifting as a piece rises toward camera, one quiet exhale closing the shot.

PERFORMANCE
Hands stay continuously busy with real working tasks, never idle. Pore-level realism: vellus arm hair in the breeze, capillary flush from cold water. Movements read practiced, unhurried, one deliberate pause at the fish-lift and one at the first bite, restrained and human, never cartoonish.

PHYSICS
No floating props. Correct contact shadows under every prop, every segment. Water carries real weight and splash. Fire holds true flicker, heat-shimmer, smoke on a light breeze. Mass and inertia carry through the rod bend, the fish's thrashing and the latch.

LIGHTING
WB locked 5600K, warm low sun behind camera-left as key, cool sky fill through A-B. From C onward, ember-orange fire light adds a low rim on hands and fish alongside the same key.

COLOR GRADE
Cool jade-green river/forest in A, warm honey wood and pale gravel in B, ember-orange fire glow and seared skin in C-D. Color tied to source and surface, not a flat list.

AUDIO
Warm acoustic guitar bed under everything, mixed low, sitting quietly beneath the natural sound. Diegetic: river current and line-whistle opening A, splash and reel-drag through the fight; gravel footsteps opening B, knife-on-wood, one clean cut sound, rinse-splash, hinge-click closing it; twig-snap opening C, crackle into sizzle; glass clink and swallow opening D, fork scrape, steam hiss, one quiet chuckle closing the shot. No subtitles.

STYLE
8K photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic. Naturalistic master cinematography, fine film grain, true action-camera color science.

OUTPUT SETTINGS
Real-time throughout, no speed ramping, FOV holds exactly as stated per segment with no drift across any hard cut.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Same hands, sleeve and wrist cord across all four segments. Same rod, knife, board, basket and bottle, no substitutions across any cut. Same river, gravel bar and fire-ring geometry held across every segment. Fish skin and flesh stay anatomically real. Eyes stay natural — no eye glow. Contact shadows read clearly every segment. No logos, no UI, no subtitles anywhere in frame.

Create a stunning, high-quality cinematic 3D animated short film set in South Korea. Use sophisticated character animation, beautifully detailed environments, realistic fabric textures, expressive faces, delicate lighting, and fluid natural movements.
The visual style should combine the charm of a beautifully animated romantic film with the emotional depth and cinematic composition of a nostalgic Korean love story.

CHARACTER DESIGN AND CONTINUITY

THE ELDERLY WOMAN — PRESENT DAY

A graceful, exceptionally beautiful 72-year-old Korean woman with delicate facial features, expressive dark eyes, elegant silver-black hair tied loosely at the back, and naturally detailed age lines.

Her face should communicate kindness, wisdom, warmth, and a lifetime of beautiful memories. Her wrinkles should be delicately rendered rather than exaggerated. Give her a gentle smile and expressive eyes that can communicate happiness and nostalgia without dialogue.

She wears a vintage cream knitted cardigan over a muted-brown dress.

Her home is an old, cozy Korean wooden house featuring traditional wooden windows, faded curtains, aged furniture, a small wooden cabinet, an old analogue clock, and warm afternoon sunlight streaming inside.

On a wooden table sits an old keepsake box containing a faded photograph and a carefully preserved deep-red knitted scarf.

THE YOUNG WOMAN — 1998 FLASHBACK

The exact same character at 23 years old.

She is exceptionally beautiful, with delicate Korean facial features, large expressive dark eyes, smooth skin, long glossy black hair with soft bangs, and a naturally charming smile.

Her character design should feel elegant, romantic, and timeless, with subtle stylization, detailed hair strands, expressive facial animation, and graceful movements.

She wears a vintage cream wool coat, an ivory blouse, a dark pleated skirt, and a beautiful deep-red knitted scarf given to her by her first love.

The scarf must have detailed wool fibers, visible knitted patterns, soft folds, and natural movement.

THE BOYFRIEND — 1998 FLASHBACK

An exceptionally handsome 25-year-old Korean man with expressive dark eyes, a naturally defined jawline, thick black hair styled in a classic late-1990s Korean fashion, and a warm, sincere smile.

He wears a charcoal wool overcoat, a cream knitted sweater, dark trousers, and vintage leather shoes.

His animated expressions should be subtle and believable. His smile should feel shy, affectionate, and genuine.

Both characters must remain visually consistent throughout the flashback, with matching facial features, hairstyles, clothing, and proportions.

SCENE 1 — THE KEEPSAKE

TIME: 0–5 SECONDS

Inside a cozy old Korean wooden house, golden autumn sunlight streams through faded curtains.

Outside the window, red, amber, and golden maple leaves drift gently through the air.

The elderly woman sits beside a wooden table and slowly opens an old wooden keepsake box.

Inside is a faded photograph of her younger self standing beside a handsome young Korean man beneath a maple tree.

A deep-red knitted scarf rests carefully beneath the photograph.

She gently lifts the scarf with both hands. Her fingers softly move across its knitted texture.

A small, affectionate smile appears on her face. Her eyes glisten with a subtle tear as she remembers her first love.

Her expression is peaceful, happy, and filled with gratitude.

CAMERA: Slow cinematic push-in, beginning with a medium shot of the woman before moving into detailed close-ups of her hands, the red scarf, and the faded photograph.

ANIMATION DETAILS: Subtle hand movements, natural blinking, gentle breathing, delicate facial expressions, and softly moving curtains.

LIGHTING: Warm amber sunlight, soft shadows, beautiful highlights on the knitted wool, and realistic light bouncing off the wooden furniture.

SCENE 2 — A HAPPY MEMORY

TIME: 5–10 SECONDS

The camera slowly moves toward the old photograph.

The photograph fills the screen, and its image gradually transforms into a living, animated memory.

Suddenly, we are transported to autumn 1998.

A beautiful young Korean woman stands beneath a magnificent maple tree in a peaceful university garden. Golden leaves float around her as a gentle breeze moves her long black hair.

She wears her cream wool coat and the deep-red knitted scarf.

Her exceptionally handsome boyfriend approaches, carrying a small paper bag from an old-fashioned Korean bakery.

He smiles shyly and gently adjusts the scarf around her neck.

She looks up at him and laughs softly.

He brushes a loose strand of hair away from her face. They exchange a warm, affectionate smile.

Their expressions should communicate the excitement and tenderness of young love.

VISUAL EFFECT: A dreamy, softly glowing atmosphere with delicate floating leaves, gentle sunlight filtering through the maple canopy, subtle depth of field, and beautifully rendered autumn colors.

The memory should feel warm, happy, and precious, as though the elderly woman is reliving her favorite moment.

CAMERA: Gentle tracking movement, intimate close-ups, and graceful transitions between their expressions.

SCENE 3 — THEIR LITTLE WORLD

TIME: 10–15 SECONDS

The young couple walks along an old stone pathway covered in colorful fallen maple leaves.

The young man playfully steps on a dry leaf, making it crackle.

The woman laughs and lightly taps his arm.

He reaches for her hand. Their fingers gently interlock.

She looks at him with a playful smile before resting her head briefly against his shoulder.

They stop beneath the magnificent maple tree.

He gently adjusts the deep-red scarf around her neck and looks into her eyes.

BOYFRIEND — NATURAL KOREAN DIALOGUE:

"너한테 잘 어울려."

ENGLISH SUBTITLE:

"It looks beautiful on you."

The woman smiles shyly, lowers her eyes, and then looks back at him.

GIRL — NATURAL KOREAN DIALOGUE:

"정말?"

ENGLISH SUBTITLE:

"Really?"

He nods and smiles warmly.

She laughs softly.

A few maple leaves float between them as they continue looking at each other.

ANIMATION DETAILS: Fluid body movement, natural eye contact, subtle smiles, gentle hair movement, realistic scarf physics, and leaves responding naturally to the breeze.

The scene should feel intimate, playful, innocent, and genuinely happy.

SCENE 4 — THE MEMORY SHE KEPT

TIME: 15–20 SECONDS

A close-up of the young woman's joyful smile.

The image softly dissolves back into the present day.

The elderly woman sits beside the window in her wooden home, holding the same deep-red scarf against her chest.

She smiles tenderly at the photograph.

Her eyes glisten with nostalgic tears, but she does not look heartbroken. Instead, she looks peaceful and grateful to have experienced such beautiful love.

She carefully places the scarf beside the photograph and gently smooths its folded edge.

Outside the window, a golden maple leaf floats past.

She looks toward the autumn trees and whispers in Korean:

"행복했어… 정말."

ENGLISH SUBTITLE:

"I was happy… truly."

FINAL SHOT

A beautifully composed close-up of the faded photograph beside the preserved red scarf.

Warm sunlight falls across the wooden table. Tiny dust particles drift through the light.

The camera slowly pulls backward, revealing the peaceful room as golden leaves move beyond the window.

Fade to black.

FINAL TEXT:

"Some memories never grow old."

title: Schoolgirl Fights Back Against Pranking Upperclassmen
desc: festival committee by day, undefeated by literally always POV: you interrupt Yuki mid-decorating "do try to help next time, senpai" — the most polite threat eve…
prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
An old wooden Japanese school corridor during festival-prep week. Yuki stands on a low wooden stepladder, tying paper crane streamers along an overhead beam. Three upperclassmen — led by Ren — approach from the corridor's far end and shove the ladder to startle her.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
@yuki: 17-year-old Japanese high school girl, black hair to shoulder blades, navy seifuku uniform, red neck tie, calm composed expression. 100% matches the reference.
@ren: 18-year-old Japanese upperclassman, short messy black hair, loosened uniform blazer, smug expression. 100% matches the reference. Two additional upperclassmen share his uniform and build, faces unremarkable and non-distinct.

LOCATION MAP
Foreground: worn wooden floorboards, paper crane streamers hanging overhead. Midground: Yuki on the stepladder, corridor stretching back toward sliding shoji-style windows. Background: soft-focus students passing at the far end of the hall. Warm light spills in from the windows on camera-left; camera holds on the shadow side.

FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING
Yuki stands mid-step on the ladder, one hand raised tying a streamer, weight balanced, facing the beam — not the camera. Ren and the two upperclassmen enter frame from the right background, walking casually.

FORMAT MODE
Timed multishot. Hard cuts only at the stated seconds; the camera does not cut on its own between them.

OPTICS
0:00–0:04 — 63° wide observational FOV. 0:04–0:09 — 47° neutral FOV, tightening to 29° on close reactions. 0:09–0:15 — 47° neutral FOV. No drift mid-segment.

CAMERA
0:00–0:02: Static low 63° wide shot from floor height, holding Yuki on the ladder mid-corridor.
0:02–0:04: Sharp handheld push-in as the ladder tips, camera drops slightly with her fall.
0:04–0:06: Rapid tracking shot alongside her cartwheel, whip-pan into a 29° close-up on her face as she lands.
0:06–0:09: 360-degree combat orbit around the group as she trades blows with two attackers.
0:09–0:12: Static 47° medium shot, holding the throw and final takedown.
0:12–0:15: Slow 47° push-in on Yuki's face as she finishes tying the streamer.

ACTION
0:00–0:02 — Yuki calmly loops a paper crane streamer around a nail on the beam, humming lightly, unaware of the group approaching.
0:02–0:04 — Ren kicks the base of the stepladder. It skids and tips sideways under real weight and momentum. Yuki loses footing but stays composed — she pushes off the falling ladder into a controlled aerial cartwheel, hair trailing with the rotation, and lands the rotation directly into a spinning back kick that catches the nearest attacker in the shoulder, pushing him back two steps. Slow-motion only through the cartwheel and kick transition, then snap to real-time on impact.
0:04–0:06 — She lands lightly, weight absorbed through bent knees. A second attacker lunges; Yuki sidesteps by centimeters, pivots, and drives a palm-block into his forearm, redirecting his momentum past her.
0:06–0:09 — Ren and the remaining attacker close in from both sides. Yuki ducks one swing, catches the other attacker's arm, and executes a hip throw that drops him to the floorboards with a controlled, realistic fall. She rotates to block Ren's incoming punch with a forearm cross-block.
0:09–0:12 — Yuki catches Ren's wrist mid-swing, steps into him, and uses his own momentum to sweep his leg out, dropping him to sit hard on the floor, winded but unharmed. All three attackers are down, sitting or kneeling, defeated without gore.
0:12–0:15 — Yuki exhales, straightens her uniform collar, and picks the fallen streamer up off the floor. She climbs back onto the ladder and resumes tying it to the beam as if nothing happened, glancing once over her shoulder at Ren with a small knowing smile. She says: "Do try to help next time, senpai."

PERFORMANCE
Yuki's expression stays unhurried throughout — no panic, no strain, breath steady even mid-fight. Micro-details: a small controlled inhale before the cartwheel, a relaxed jaw during the throw, genuine amusement (not mockery) in the closing smile.

PHYSICS
Full gravity and inertia: the ladder skids and tips before she leaves it, her landings absorb through the knees, thrown attackers hit the floor with real contact weight and a puff of dust from the boards. No floating, no weightless movement.

LIGHTING
Warm natural window light from camera-left at a low afternoon angle, soft haze in the corridor air. Camera stays on the shadow side throughout for contrast. White balance 4500K.

COLOR GRADE
Warm wood tones and cream uniform whites as the dominant palette, deep navy from the uniforms as the secondary, and the red of Yuki's neck tie as the only accent color. No cool or saturated artificial lighting anywhere in the scene — grade stays warm and naturalistic.

WARDROBE
Yuki's seifuku and Ren's blazer stay clean, no tears or damage — this is a schoolyard scuffle, not a brawl. Fabric moves naturally with each motion.

AUDIO
Footsteps on wood, fabric rustle, controlled impact thuds, one soft laugh from Yuki before her line. No music.

STYLE
Ultra-photorealistic live-action, naturalistic Japanese school setting, realistic hair and fabric physics, natural skin texture, physically accurate contact shadows, subtle motion blur on fast moves, 8K detail, shallow depth of field.

OUTPUT SETTINGS
16:9. Real-time throughout except the controlled slow-motion window specified in the 0:02–0:04 beat, which snaps back to real-time on impact.

POSITIVE LOCKS
@yuki keeps the same face, hairstyle, uniform, and tie throughout. @ren and the two other upperclassmen keep consistent uniforms and builds across every cut. The stepladder remains a stepladder — no prop transformation. No teleportation between beats; every position change follows visible, continuous motion. No blood, no visible injury, no exaggerated magic effects.

prompt:
What if you could see what Da Vinci NEVER painted?

I went INSIDE The Last Supper using Seedance 2.5 in @FishCreativeHQ

Prompt👇

upload the painting image as first frame and use this video prompt

[First-Frame.png] Create a 20-second vertical 9:16 image-to-video film, using the supplied image as the exact first frame and matching final frame. One continuous camera journey through the room, with macro detail, a gradual emotional reveal, an orbit behind the central figure and a seamless return.

Build the supplied scene as complete 3D geometry while preserving its Renaissance oil-painted appearance. The table stands in real space, the tablecloth drapes over its edges, the food and vessels sit on its surface, and every figure has a fully dimensional body beneath their robes. As the camera passes around them, reveal the sides and rear surfaces hidden from the opening viewpoint. Retain the original brushwork, warm earthy colours, soft daylight and expressive faces.

IDENTIFY AND PRESERVE THE FIGURES

The central figure sits at the middle of the table. He has long wavy brown hair, a full brown beard and downcast, calm eyes. He wears a deep red robe with a rich blue mantle draped across his left shoulder and lap. His right hand rests palm-down on the tablecloth at the left of the frame; his left hand lies open, palm-up, beside a small glass of red wine.

To his right (left of frame) sits a young apostle with long golden-brown hair, a green mantle over a red garment, his sorrowful gaze turned toward the centre. In front of him, a balding older man with a dark beard, wearing red and blue, leans in with a pointing gesture. A partly visible figure with curly hair sits at the far left edge.

To his left (right of frame) a man with thick black curly hair and a dark beard, in a blue robe, turns to speak with a grey-bearded elder in an olive-green robe at the right edge, who raises both hands in an open, questioning gesture.

Keep every pose, gesture, gaze direction and costume exactly as in the reference. No figure moves.

THE ROOM AND TABLE

A dark coffered wooden ceiling. A grey back wall with three tall windows opening onto a sunlit Tuscan landscape of blue hills, cypress trees, terracotta villas and a bell tower. Dark blue and gold damask panels on both side walls.

A long table covered in white linen with a visible grid of fold creases, hanging almost to the floor. On it: scattered bread rolls and crumbs, pewter plates, a central plate of fish, the small glass of red wine, a bowl of green olives, a plate of red and green grapes at the right, a blue-and-white decorated bowl with bread at the left, and a dark glazed ceramic jug at the far left. Wooden trestle legs and the hems of robes are visible below the cloth.

0–3 SECONDS — ENTER OVER THE BREAD

Begin on the exact supplied image for approximately half a second.

The camera then flies forward into the room and descends toward the bread roll resting on the tablecloth just left of centre. Pass macro-close above it.

Reveal the roll's rounded volume, cracked golden crust, flour-dusted ridges and the small crumbs scattered around it, each casting a tiny shadow on the linen. The nearest crust passes softly out of focus beneath the lens as the camera glides on.

The tablecloth has physical relief: woven threads, raised fold creases and shallow dips where objects press into it. The bread falls behind the moving camera while the central figure stays fixed farther into the room. This changing perspective establishes real depth immediately.

3–7 SECONDS — GLIDE ACROSS THE TABLE TO THE WINE

Travel low and smoothly across the linen toward the centre of the table, skimming past the rim of the fish plate. Reveal the plate's worn pewter edge, its curved depth and the painted fish resting inside.

Continue to the small glass of red wine. Curve partly around it at macro distance, revealing the thickness of the glass, the flat surface of the wine, and daylight from the windows refracting through it as a soft red glow on the cloth.

The glass crosses the near foreground, the open palm-up hand appears just beyond it, and the back wall shifts more slowly behind. Maintain forward momentum throughout.

7–10 SECONDS — RISE ALONG THE OPEN HAND AND MANTLE

Rise past the open hand, revealing the gentle curve of the fingers, the creases of the palm and its weight resting on the cloth.

Continue upward along the blue mantle where it falls across his lap and left shoulder. Travel close to the fabric without touching it. Show the painted texture, the deep blue folds as dimensional surfaces: raised crests catch the window light, undersides fall into shadow, and the red robe shows beneath the mantle's edge.

The blue fabric passes beside the lens as his face comes into view above.

10–13 SECONDS — REVEAL THE CENTRAL FACE

Curve inward and slightly upward toward his face.

Approach a close view of his lowered eyes, calm brow, nose and the soft strands of his beard and hair. Preserve the exact face from the reference. Reveal the three-dimensional shape of the cheekbones and brow, and the subtle painted texture of the skin, fully connected to his neck and shoulders.

Ease the camera's speed for approximately one second while continuing a gentle sideways drift. Let the stillness and quiet sorrow register. He does not move; the emotion comes from discovering the expression already present in the painting.

13–17 SECONDS — ORBIT BEHIND HIM TO THE WINDOW

Continue past the outside of his face, over his blue-draped left shoulder, and orbit smoothly behind him into the narrow space between his back and the central window.

Reveal the back of his long wavy hair, the rear folds of the blue mantle and red robe, and the thickness of his shoulders beneath the fabric. His shoulder passes close beside the lens as a soft foreground shape.

Turn gently to look past him through the central window: the sunlit Tuscan hills, cypresses and villas gain real depth, the far hills hazy and the near trees sharper. Then continue the arc so the view swings back over his other shoulder, revealing from behind the backs of the apostles' heads, the young apostle's green mantle, and the whole table spread out before them toward where the viewer began.

17–20 SECONDS — RETURN TO THE ORIGINAL COMPOSITION

Rise and retreat in one smooth arc over the table, passing above the grey-bearded elder's raised open hands at the right, then curving back onto the opening camera axis.

Reveal all figures again in their exact positions. The bread, plates, wine glass, olives, grapes, decorated bowl and ceramic jug settle back onto the table as in the supplied image. The coffered ceiling, three windows and damask walls realign with the frame.

Gently decelerate into the exact opening viewpoint, lens perspective, framing and lighting. End on a frame matching the supplied image so the next repetition flows directly into the opening movement.

CAMERA, STYLE AND CONTINUITY

Use one uninterrupted physical camera path: over the bread, across the table to the wine, up the open hand and blue mantle, to the central face, around behind him to the window, back over his shoulder and out to the original wide composition.

Use natural motion blur and shallow depth of field during macro passes. Transfer focus smoothly to the next detail along the route. Foreground objects pass the lens because the camera moves around them; no figure changes pose, blinks, speaks or moves toward the camera.

Maintain one coherent room with stable geometry and consistent warm daylight from the windows. Hidden surfaces belong to the existing figures, clothing, table and walls and match their visible design. Preserve the oil painting's brushwork, canvas texture and colour at every scale.

No cuts, crash zooms, dissolves, flat canvas flyovers, wall-relief effects, scene morphing, additional people, new props, extra food, text or watermark.

title: POV Cliff Jump into a Turquoise Volcanic Canyon Spring
desc: omg...Seedance 2.5 can do real POV physics now one prompt on @FishCreativeHQ.. bookmark this 👇 Prompt: SEEDANCE 2.5 | TEXT TO VIDEO | SINGLE CONTINUOUS TAKE | …
prompt:
SEEDANCE 2.5 | TEXT TO VIDEO | SINGLE CONTINUOUS TAKE | 22s | 1080x1920 | 9:16 | 30fps | 1080p

SCENE AND LOCATION
A hidden volcanic spring canyon deep in a Pacific Northwest pine forest on a bright summer day. A narrow, deep gorge with steep, very high walls of dark gray basalt made of vertical hexagonal columns, streaked with tan and rust tones and covered in patches of bright green moss, ferns and small shrubs.
At the bottom is a crystal-clear natural spring pool. The shallow edges glow bright turquoise and aqua, fading to deep sapphire blue in the center. The water is so transparent that the bottom is fully visible: honeycomb-patterned volcanic rock, mossy boulders, and two long pale submerged logs lying diagonally across the bottom.
Two white waterfalls pour into the pool: a thin one at the far back of the canyon and a larger one spilling from the right-hand cliff wall, making white foam where it hits the water. Tall dark-green conifer and pine trees line the canyon rim. Above is a vivid clear blue sky with a few small white clouds. Hard, bright midday sunlight with strong contrast, and sun sparkles on the water.

THE JUMPER
A young man seen only from his own first-person view. Tanned bare feet and lightly hairy shins, and loose navy-blue swim shorts with a large mustard-yellow hibiscus flower pattern and white drawstrings. No shirt, no shoes, no gloves. His hands and forearms appear naturally in frame when he moves them.

CAMERA AND REALISM
First-person POV from a GoPro strapped to his forehead. It looks like real action-cam footage, not a cinematic camera. 16mm-equivalent ultra-wide lens with slight barrel distortion, and saturated but natural color.
Use real action-cam behavior throughout: small head bob and micro-jitter from breathing and body weight, rolling-shutter wobble on fast moves, quick auto-exposure shifts between bright sky and the shaded canyon, a small sun flare on upward tilts, light sensor noise in the shadows, and wind buffeting that shakes the frame during the fall.
The cliff is about 35 meters high. Gravity, body motion and water physics are fully realistic.

0-2s | THE EDGE (real time)
POV looking straight down from the top of the basalt cliff. His bare feet stand on the rough, dark rock ledge at the bottom of frame, with the shorts visible at the lower edge. Both hands hover forward at the sides of frame. The turquoise pool, the submerged logs and the waterfalls are far, far below. His toes curl over the edge and small grit crumbles off. His right hand tosses a pink-and-white striped inflatable tube out over the drop; it tumbles down and lands as a tiny speck on the water far below. Wind, distant waterfall roar, upbeat chill electronic music starts.

2-4s | THE COUNTDOWN (real time)
A quick nervous tilt down at the drop, a sharp exhale, then two fast steps back from the edge, with the ledge bouncing in frame. Young male voice, hyped: "Three, two, one!"

4-7s | THE TAKEOFF (natural slow motion, about 50% speed)
Two running steps forward, then his last foot pushes off the ledge in slow motion. Rock grit kicks up and floats in the sunlight, the cliff edge slides away beneath his feet, his arms swing forward and out wide, and the whole turquoise canyon opens up below. The slow motion looks like a real high-frame-rate action-cam clip, not a frozen hang. Deep bass swell, stretched wind.

7-13s | THE FALL (real time, fast and continuous)
The speed ramps smoothly back to normal and the stomach drops.
7-9s: The frame dips and wobbles, his arms flail slightly for balance at the edges of frame, and his feet kick at the bottom of frame. A loud yell: "Woooooo!"
9-11s: The basalt column wall, moss and ferns streak upward past the lens, and the right-side waterfall rushes by with spray catching the sun. Wind roars louder and the frame shakes from air buffeting.
11-13s: The glowing turquoise water rushes up and fills the frame, and the pink tube and submerged logs grow fast. His arms snap tight to his body and his legs lock straight for a feet-first pencil dive. The music builds to the drop.

13-14s | IMPACT
A hard feet-first hit into the water and a white explosion of bubbles swallows the lens. Loud plunge splash, deep impact whoosh, and the music goes heavily muffled underwater.

14-17s | UNDERWATER (short, energetic, real time)
A violent swirl of silver bubbles clears to reveal crystal-clear blue water, bright sun shafts cutting down from the surface, the pale submerged logs and honeycomb volcanic rock bottom below, and small fish darting away. His hands push into frame for one strong breaststroke pull, then fast kicks straight up toward the bright glowing surface, with bubbles streaming past the lens. No slow sinking.

17-19s | SURFACE BREAK
The camera bursts through the surface, water droplets sliding across the lens, and bright sunlight floods in. The music snaps back to full clarity on the beat drop. His hand grabs the pink-and-white tube floating right beside him.

19-22s | THE REWARD
POV bobbing on the turquoise water holding the tube, then a sharp tilt up revealing the towering basalt cliff, the tiny ledge he jumped from far above, the pine trees on the rim and the vivid blue sky, with the waterfall splashing on the right. Same voice, out of breath and triumphant: "Yeah, dude! That was insane!" Faint distant cheering. Music plays clean to the final frame.

AUDIO
Continuous upbeat chill electronic track: a bass swell on takeoff, a fast build through the fall, muffled underwater, then a clean drop on surfacing. Real ambient layers: wind that grows with speed, fabric flapping, heavy breathing, waterfall roar, splash, bubbles. Dialogue clear over the music.

KEEP
One continuous take, first-person only. The same shorts, feet and hands throughout, and the same canyon layout with two waterfalls, turquoise pool and submerged logs. The slow motion lasts only 3 seconds at takeoff. The fall is fast, real time and builds speed without pausing. Every beat is quick and punchy.

AVOID
Extra slow motion beyond the takeoff, hovering or floating mid-air, smooth cinematic gimbal movement, cuts to third person, showing the jumper's face, extra people, distorted hands or extra fingers, morphing cliffs, changing water color, text, subtitles, watermarks.

SCENE CONTEXT
A 20-year-old East Asian woman spends an autumn day moving through a big city — leaving her apartment, riding the subway, grabbing coffee from a cart, cutting through a park in falling leaves, browsing a bookstore, catching golden hour on a rooftop, and riding home at night — filmed as a candid, mixed-format day-in-the-city vlog, 30 seconds total.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
@image1: 20-year-old East Asian woman, soft round face, warm ivory skin, dark brown hair in a loose high bun with face-framing strands, natural dewy makeup, gentle expressive eyes, wearing a wine-burgundy ribbed knit off-shoulder sweater and a small silver flower pendant necklace. 100% matches the reference throughout every shot.

FORMAT MODE
Timed multishot. HARD CUTs only at the stated seconds; camera does not cut on its own between them. Mixed scene styles — not every shot has dialogue; some are silent candid b-roll.

0.0s–4.0s — HARD CUT
4.0s–8.0s — HARD CUT
8.0s–12.0s — HARD CUT
12.0s–17.0s — HARD CUT
17.0s–21.0s — HARD CUT
21.0s–26.0s — HARD CUT
26.0s–30.0s — end

OPTICS
Shot 1: 63° wide, POV-adjacent handheld. Shot 2: 47° neutral, static-ish lean. Shot 3: 29° portrait-compression, quick transactional. Shot 4: 18° natural-portrait, slow-mo detail. Shot 5: 29° portrait-compression, candid unaware angle. Shot 6: 47° neutral, two-shot-adjacent solo toast. Shot 7: 18° natural-portrait, close reflective. No drift mid-segment.

CAMERA
Handheld throughout with natural 1–2cm tremor. Shot 1: phone-height POV-style, walking at 4 km/h. Shot 2: camera rests low against a pole, minimal movement, observational. Shot 3: quick whip from hand to face and back. Shot 4: slowed to half real-time, camera drifts sideways at 1 km/h following falling leaves. Shot 5: camera appears to catch her off-guard, slight delay before she notices it. Shot 6: static-ish, propped, she moves into frame. Shot 7: static through car window glass, reflections passing over her face.

ACTION
0.0s–4.0s: She steps out of an apartment building onto a leaf-scattered sidewalk, adjusting her bag strap, glancing at her phone, morning light low and warm through bare branches. She looks up at the camera briefly, half-smiles: "Okay — let's do this."

4.0s–8.0s: Inside a subway car, she leans against a pole, earbuds in, watching the platform lights blur past the window, city sounds muffled and rhythmic. No dialogue — just her quiet, unbothered expression, occasional sway with the train's motion.

8.0s–12.0s: At a small street coffee cart, steam rising from the machine, she hands over cash, receives a paper cup, wraps both hands around it immediately for warmth. Brief exchange, she says only: "Thanks, you're the best."

12.0s–17.0s: Slow-motion through a park path thick with falling amber leaves, she tips her head back mid-step and turns once, leaves catching in her hair and sweater, genuine unguarded laugh, no spoken line — just breath and laughter audible.

17.0s–21.0s: Inside a small bookstore, she runs a finger along a shelf, pulls a book halfway out, flips a few pages, unaware of the camera, soft window light across her face, ambient store quiet. No dialogue.

21.0s–26.0s: On a rooftop at golden hour, city skyline hazy behind her, she raises a takeaway coffee cup slightly toward the lens like a small toast, warm low sun rim-lighting her hair, says only: "To days like this."

26.0s–30.0s: Inside a taxi at night, warm amber streetlights sliding across the window glass and over her face in soft passing bands, she rests her head against the seat, tired contented smile, looks toward the lens and says: "Best day, hands down."

PERFORMANCE
Restrained, natural reactions — no performed excitement. Shots 2 and 5 specifically read as candid/unaware of the camera. Living eyes with catch-light in every close shot, visible breath in shot 1, natural skin and fabric texture throughout.

PHYSICS
Leaves fall and scatter with real weight and drift, catching briefly in hair and sweater fibers before falling away. Coffee steam rises and dissipates naturally. Streetlight bands move across her face and the window glass with correct parallax as the car moves. Train sway shifts her weight subtly and believably.

LIGHTING
Shot 1: low warm morning sun through bare branches, soft shadow lines. Shot 2: cool fluorescent subway light with warm practicals flickering past outside. Shot 3: overcast daylight, soft even key. Shot 4: dappled warm sun through park canopy, backlit leaf edges. Shot 5: soft window-diffused daylight, low contrast. Shot 6: warm low-angle golden hour key, strong rim light, soft haze. Shot 7: warm amber sodium streetlight passing bands only, otherwise dark interior.

COLOR GRADE
Warm autumn palette — amber, rust, and soft gold tones with muted city grays. Warm amber streetlight at night, never neon or saturated colored signage anywhere in frame. No cool-cyan or magenta tint.

WARDROBE
Wine-burgundy ribbed knit off-shoulder sweater and silver flower pendant necklace, unchanged and clearly visible in every shot. A loosely draped scarf or open coat may sit over it in the subway and taxi shots without covering it.

AUDIO
Shot 1: quiet street ambience, rustling leaves. Shot 2: muffled train rumble, distant announcement, no dialogue. Shot 3: espresso machine hiss, brief exchange. Shot 4: crunch of leaves, natural laughter, no line. Shot 5: quiet store ambience, page-turning, no dialogue. Shot 6: distant city hum, wind. Shot 7: engine hum, soft radio murmur under her line.

STYLE
Authentic day-in-the-life vlog cinematography, dreamy 35mm film aesthetic, fine natural grain, realistic autofocus hunting, mix of talking and silent candid shots for a lived-in, unscripted feel.

OUTPUT SETTINGS
4K, 24fps, 35mm grain, real-time except shot 4 (half real-time slow motion), realistic handheld motion, no neon or saturated signage in the color palette anywhere.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Same woman's face and build in every shot, matching @image1 exactly. Wine-burgundy sweater and silver necklace stay visible in every shot. Hair stays in the same loose high bun throughout. Cuts only at stated seconds, camera does not cut on its own. Shots 2 and 5 stay dialogue-free and candid. Warm amber tones hold throughout — no neon, no cool-cyan tint anywhere.

The witch stands completely composed among the fallen attackers. She gently adjusts her sleeve, turns around, and continues walking down the lantern-lit street.

A terrified elderly merchant watches her disappear into the darkness and quietly whispers:

Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic personal home-video of a young Korean woman confidently attempting to learn a viral TikTok dance trend in her tiny apartment, with her furniture and coordination working against her the entire time. No reference image.

**MAIN SUBJECT**

Young Korean woman in her early 20s, casual and determined energy, natural makeup, expression that shifts from focused confidence to flustered embarrassment.

Hair in a messy half-up bun, a few strands sticking to her face as she gets more flustered, small stud earrings.

Wearing an oversized band t-shirt tucked loosely into biker shorts, white ankle socks, no shoes, phone propped up against a stack of books on the floor to "record for practice."

Maintain the same face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and appearance throughout the entire video.

**SETTING**

A small, cluttered studio apartment living room, evening, warm lamp light mixed with the cool glow of a laptop screen playing the dance tutorial video.

A coffee table pushed slightly out of the way but not far enough, a floor lamp standing a little too close to her "stage area," a pile of laundry on the couch, a half-full water glass on the side table, string lights on the wall, and a roommate's bike leaning against the wall in the background. Cramped, real, an apartment clearly not built for dancing.

**CAMERA / VISUAL AESTHETIC**

Raw personal footage, filmed by her roommate on a phone propped up at first, then grabbed handheld once things go wrong — strong handheld vlog shake for the second half.

Static, slightly low-angle framing for the "practice" shots, mimicking a phone-on-a-stack-of-books setup. Frame is imperfectly centered, cutting off the top of her head slightly. Once the roommate grabs the phone, autofocus hunts, motion blur kicks in during the collision moment, exposure shifts as she moves between lamp light and shadow, visible digital noise in the dim room.

No stabilization, no gimbal smoothness, no cinematic camera moves — it should feel like a real phone recording that was never meant to be watched by anyone but her.

---

**00:00–00:05 — THE CONFIDENT SETUP**

She props her phone against a stack of books, steps back into frame, and shakes out her arms like an athlete warming up.

She points at the laptop screen playing the dance tutorial, then back at herself, deadly serious.

*"Okay. I've watched this like twenty times. I got this."*

**00:05–00:10 — FIRST EIGHT-COUNT**

The music starts. She nails the first few moves surprisingly well, sharp and confident, clearly proud of herself mid-move.

Roommate's voice from off-screen, genuinely impressed: *"Wait, okay—?!"*

The camera stays static, catching her in full frame, a rare clean moment.

**00:10–00:15 — THE FIRST WOBBLE**

A quick turn in the choreography catches her off guard — she spins a half-second late, arms flailing to catch up, and clips the edge of the coffee table with her shin.

She yelps, hopping on one foot, still trying to keep the rhythm going through gritted teeth.

*"I'm fine — I'm fine, keep going—"*

**00:15–00:20 — LAMP INCIDENT**

Recovering, she throws herself into the next big arm movement — her hand clips the floor lamp, sending it tilting dangerously.

Her roommate lunges into frame to catch it, grabbing the phone off the books in the process, camera suddenly handheld and shaking.

*"THE LAMP—"*

**00:20–00:25 — FULL CHAOS**

With the lamp saved but the camera now shaky and handheld, she tries to pick the choreography back up from memory, increasingly out of sync with the music, arms going in directions the dance never intended.

She knocks the water glass off the side table with her elbow, doesn't even stop, just grimaces and keeps dancing through the spill.

Roommate, laughing hysterically behind the now-unsteady camera: *"You're literally destroying the apartment—"*

**00:25–00:30 — FINAL MOMENT**

The song ends. She strikes a triumphant final pose — chest heaving, one hand on her hip, completely out of breath, water pooling near her sock.

She looks into the camera, dead serious despite the disaster around her.

*"...Post it. That was clean."*

Her roommate, still laughing, pans the camera slowly down to the spilled water and tipped lamp before swinging back to her unbothered face — and the footage cuts abruptly to black.

---

**AUDIO**

Natural location sound only:

The tutorial/dance track playing tinny from the laptop speakers, her footsteps and fabric movement, the thud of her shin hitting the table, the lamp wobbling and roommate's scramble to catch it, glass tipping and water spilling, her roommate's genuine off-camera laughter throughout, and handheld camera noise once it's picked up.

No added music beyond the in-scene laptop track. No narration. No artificial sound effects.

Spoken lines: *"Okay. I've watched this like twenty times. I got this."* / *"Wait, okay—?!"* (roommate) / *"I'm fine — I'm fine, keep going—"* / *"THE LAMP—"* (roommate) / *"You're literally destroying the apartment—"* (roommate) / *"...Post it. That was clean."*

**FINAL FEEL**

Chaotic, cramped-apartment energy — the universal experience of confidently trying a viral dance and immediately losing a fight with your own furniture. Funny, physical, unscripted-feeling, with a deadpan ending that lands harder because she genuinely doesn't acknowledge the destruction around her.

No exaggerated slapstick beyond real physical missteps. No professional dance skill required — the comedy comes from real momentum, real near-misses, and her total refusal to admit defeat.
